method: Read-only ZIP/XML inspection of every worksheet. Formula definitions and cached results read, not recalculated.

schedule.caveat: Due date inferred from due-next-week header; no precise deadline time established.

ambiguities.issue: No prediction or collection timestamp is defined as a column; store run-level cutoffs and collection provenance separately.
Example package creation is 2026-07-01 but example publication is 2026-04-08; examples cannot form one chronological record.
Five severity targets include unknown, whereas worklog describes a four-tuple. Preserve all five contract columns.
At prediction and at outcome end require historical advisory state. Current metadata alone is not sufficient evidence.
Targets affect any version of the package, not necessarily the exact version named in the record PURL.
